about: Ormi round-2 picks (FFX-2 only, Chapter 6): LoRA r2 (ormi-x2-r2.safetensors = step 1500) + OpenPose (round2 skeletons) + the idle as IP-Adapter reference at 0.3. Tags are renders under D:/Tools/pyrefly-lora/ormi/r2/poses/<state>/. Boxes are in RAW-frame pixels (sheet-r2.py subtracts the installed cropBox). scale: sidecar 'scale' so the head matches idle's within 5 percent (measure.py; idle head 122.7 px). Scores are the painter's own at 1:1 (criteria of sets/ormi/round3/judge.md, the score is the worst, the bar is 7); an independent judge is still owed.
